subject.name: Sensor and IoT (SIoT)
subject.source: Syllabus/Diploma_Full_Collection_1/Marwadi_Official_Diploma_Collector/Marwadi_Diploma_Syllabus_Collection/Verified_Syllabi/Diploma Information and Communication Technology/Semester_Unspecified/09CT0608 - Sensors and IoT (.pdf

content: Definitions, core concepts, related concepts, IoT reference models
IoT architectures, challenges, IoT functional stack
Working principles, different types, selection of sensors for practical
applications, Introduction to different types of sensors such as
capacitive, resistive, temperature, humidity, pressure, ultrasonic
gas, Hall effect, PIR, MEMS, Image, IR, Proximity, GPS and GSM
module, Interfacing sensor with IoT hardware boards
Bluetooth and BLE, Wifi, Zigbee, IPv6, 6LowPAN, LTE-M, RFID, NFC
Application layer: MQTT, CoAP, XMPP, Integrating internet services
with interoperable data encoding with XML, JSON, CBOR, sensor markup
language, lightweight web services for IoT
IoT application domains: Smart Cities, Smart Manufacturing, Smart Grid
Smart Buildings, Intelligent Transportation Systems, Healthcare
